subject.title: fix(github-copilot): redact credential-shaped text in embedding API errors

question: Should reflected GitHub Copilot embedding error bodies always use forced tools-mode redaction regardless of the operator's general logging-redaction setting?
rationale: The implementation and proof support this choice, but it establishes permanent behavior at a credential-safety boundary and therefore needs explicit feature-owner or security-owner confirmation.

options.title: Approve forced boundary redaction
options.body: Refresh onto current main, verify the exact head and required gate, then land the unconditional redaction behavior with the supplied regression coverage.

options.title: Request a different boundary contract
options.body: Pause the PR only if maintainers want a narrower structured sanitizer or another repository-wide redaction policy instead of forced tools mode.

recommendation.title: Approve forced boundary redaction
recommendation.body: Refresh onto current main, verify the exact head and required gate, then land the unconditional redaction behavior with the supplied regression coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the affected embedding provider and are the strongest available feature-history owner for confirming its error contract.
